messages.content: Alice: I paid for our train tickets to Paris: €180 total. Split 3 ways equally.
Bob: The scenery from the train is amazing! So many vineyards.
Charlie: I got snacks for the journey: €36. Shared between all three of us.
Alice: What's the weather forecast for Paris this week?
Bob: I paid for the taxi from station to hotel: €45. Split equally.
Charlie: This hotel has a great view of the Eiffel Tower!
Alice: Museum entry tickets were €75 total for all three of us.
Bob: I'm getting hungry. Anyone want to find a café?
Charlie: I covered lunch at the bistro: €90. Split equally.
Alice: Actually, I got a €12 refund on the museum tickets for Bob and me.
Bob: The Louvre was incredible! So much art to see.
Charlie: I paid for metro passes: €60. Split 3 ways.
Alice: Dinner at the Italian restaurant was €120 total for all of us.
Bob: This gelato is amazing! Best I've ever had.
Charlie: I got groceries for breakfast: €42. Shared between Bob and me.
Alice: What time are we meeting for the Seine cruise tomorrow?
Bob: I paid for the boat tickets: €75. Split equally.
Charlie: The sunset over the river is breathtaking!
Alice: I covered the wine tasting: €96. Charlie and Bob owe me.
Bob: Actually, the wine tour gave us a €18 refund for Alice and me.
Charlie: The morning croissants were delicious! Best way to start the day.
Alice: I paid for the Eiffel Tower tickets: €54 total for all three.
Bob: The view from the top is spectacular! You can see all of Paris.
Charlie: Lunch at the café was €78. Split equally among us.
Alice: Should we visit Montmartre or the Latin Quarter this afternoon?
Bob: I got souvenirs for everyone: €90 total. Shared cost.
Charlie: The artist square in Montmartre is so vibrant!
Alice: I covered dinner reservations: €150. Bob and Charlie owe me.
Bob: This French cuisine is incredible! Worth every euro.
Charlie: Actually, the restaurant gave a €30 discount for Alice and me.
Alice: Tomorrow we should visit Versailles. The palace is magnificent.
Bob: I paid for Versailles train tickets: €42. Split 3 ways.
Charlie: The gardens at Versailles are enormous! So much walking.
Alice: Palace entry was €60 total for all of us.
Bob: I'm getting thirsty. Anyone want to find a water fountain?
Charlie: I got drinks and snacks: €48. Shared between Alice and me.
Alice: The Hall of Mirrors is breathtaking! So much gold.
Bob: I covered the audio guide rental: €36. Split equally.
Charlie: Lunch at the palace café was €105. Alice and Bob owe me.
Alice: Actually, we got a €15 student discount for Bob and Charlie.
Bob: The train ride back to Paris was relaxing.
Charlie: I paid for dinner tonight: €135. Split 3 ways.
Alice: This crepe stand has the best Nutella crepes!
Bob: Dessert was €27 total for all three of us.
Charlie: The night lights on the Seine are magical.
Alice: I got tickets for the Moulin Rouge show: €240. Shared cost.
Bob: The can-can dancers are amazing! So much energy.
Charlie: Drinks during the show were €72. Alice and Bob owe me.
Alice: What time does our flight leave tomorrow?
Bob: Actually, the hotel gave us a €24 late checkout refund for Charlie and me.

queries.question: Based on the memories from our previous dialogs, calculate for each person their total spending and determine who owes money to whom for settlement. Provide a final settlement plan showing all necessary transactions to clear all debts. Format your answer as a concise list of transactions only, using the format: [Person A] pays [amount] to [Person B], etc.
